Yes, exactly. Nothing should move, expire, or disappear on its own. If I mark something to read later, it should wait for me however long that takes — a day or a year — and still be there when I get to it; I'd be upset if something I meant to read quietly vanished because too much time passed. Same with the archive: things I've set aside should stay set aside until *I* decide to bring them back or get rid of them.

The whole point for me is that I'm in control and the app is dependable. It only changes a bookmark's status when I ask it to — mark it read, restore it, delete it. It never quietly cleans up or reshuffles my stuff behind my back. That's the trustworthy behavior I want.
